pipelineSteps.detail: Our systems specialists analyze your existing software costs and operational workflows, size your storage and user requirements, and design a customized, predictable plan.
Our engineering team sets up, configures, and isolates your dedicated private business system environment, establishing bank-grade encryption and security protections.
Engineers set up your central Single Sign-On directory, configure multi-factor authentication (MFA), link custom corporate domains, and verify encryption certificates.
Following thorough pre-flight verification, your team receives turnkey single-login access to InsightOS. Our engineering team proactively monitors health, backups, and security 24/7.

faqs.question: Can we start on Tier 3 (Productivity & Vault) and add just one specific tool from Tier 4 or 5 without paying for an entire tier upgrade?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Our systems are built with total modularity. If your organization chooses Tier 03 (Productivity & Vault) but needs an individual specialized tool—such as legally-binding digital contract e-signatures, automated workflow bridging, or customer support ticketing—we can provision that single module into your private environment. Your monthly retainer only adjusts incrementally for that single component, meaning you are never forced into a full Tier 04 or 05 package upgrade unless you choose to adopt the entire suite.

faqs.question: Do our employees need separate usernames and passwords for each tool?
faqs.answer: No. Every deployment includes our Unified Single Sign-On (SSO) and access gateway. Your employees use one single master secure login with multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access every application in your package—whether that's your ERP, CRM, document hub, team chat, or password vault. This eliminates password sprawl, stops employees from having to memorize or write down 12 different passwords, and allows management to instantly grant or revoke access in one click.

faqs.question: How do you handle disaster recovery if a local African data center experiences an outage?
faqs.answer: We take automated, encrypted, deduplicated snapshots of your entire system and replicate them to a secondary secure target—either another African data center (such as Angani or LiquidC2) or an encrypted offsite backup, depending on your organization's data protection policy. Recovery time objective (RTO) is under 15 minutes, with regularly tested recovery drills.

faqs.question: Can our organization upgrade between tiers without losing historical data?
faqs.answer: Yes, seamlessly. Because our entire architecture is modular, declarative, and isolated, moving up a tier simply means our engineering team provisions the new software modules directly into your existing corporate environment and links user permissions via Single Sign-On. No database migrations, downtime, or vendor export penalties are involved.

faqs.question: How are our business systems kept isolated, resilient, and fast?
faqs.answer: We use enterprise-grade virtualization and high-availability application clustering. This ensures your software has dedicated memory and compute resources, automatic failover if a hardware server requires maintenance, and isolated high-performance storage that guarantees fast document indexing and transaction speeds.

faqs.question: How does Julz Insight ensure compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 and GDPR?
faqs.answer: By housing 100% of production data within Kenyan and African borders (Safaricom, Servercore, Konza, or your corporate headquarters), you eliminate cross-border data transfer legal liabilities. Furthermore, 24/7 security auditing continuously monitors system access, Single Sign-On maintains tamper-evident audit trails, and all files are encrypted at rest with military-grade AES-256.

faqs.question: What is the ROI comparison between Julz Insight and foreign platforms like Microsoft 365 or Salesforce?
faqs.answer: Most African enterprises experience a 65% to 85% net reduction in total cost of ownership (TCO) over 24 months. Proprietary foreign software vendors charge per-user, per-month in US Dollars, subjecting your budget to local currency devaluations and price hikes. Julz Insight charges transparent flat or tiered monthly retainers in local currency (KES) with predictable SLAs and zero per-seat licensing penalties.

faqs.question: Is third-party cloud or bare-metal hosting included in the monthly retainer?
faqs.answer: No. Julz Insight maintains strict infrastructure neutrality. The visible retainers cover our fully managed software stack, custom automation, security hardening, and 24/7 proactive engineering support. Underlying cloud or bare-metal compute (via Safaricom, Servercore, Konza, iXAfrica, or your corporate headquarters) is contracted directly with or billed transparently by the sovereign data center provider. This ensures your organization retains full legal hardware ownership, zero host markup, and complete freedom from proprietary vendor lock-in.
